summary: Diff adds new HotPickSection component and updates the floating HOT PICK button (HotFab). However, several BuildRequest requirements cannot be confirmed from the provided diff excerpts (verbatim SEO text, GA4 event parameters, CTA links, required image asset file, and ensuring HOT PICK is last section). Diff summary also indicates multiple unrelated styling/SEO/asset/tracking changes beyond HOT PICK scope.
